# Contract: clean-audio

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: video. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Measured voice cleanup with matched-loudness before/after samples and a speech-clarity guard.

## Use it for
- "clean up the audio"
- "remove hum and background noise"

## Not for
- remove music or another voice under the speaker (filters cannot; say so)

## Accepted inputs
A video or a rough-cut workspace.

## Deliverables
Matched-loudness before/after samples, cleaned clips or <name>_clean.<ext>, cleanup report.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+
- NumPy
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)
- faster-whisper or mlx-whisper in rough-cut/.venv (weights 0.5-1.5 GB on first use)

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Whisper small weights (about 0.5 GB) download on first clarity check.

## Cost-sensitive operations
Model download and CPU time.

## Workflow
1. Listen test first
2. Apply
3. Report

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Listen to the before/after and approve the strength

## Quality checks
- Loudness matched before comparing
- Clarity check: no lost words
- A person listens

## Common failures
- Overlapping voices or music remain
- Too-strong denoise makes speech watery (stepped down automatically)

## Limitations
- Filters cannot separate overlapping sources
